from pathlib import Path
p = Path('alpha_w01_batch_01_solver.py')
s = p.read_text()
a = s.index('    # Curve residuals estimate')
b = s.index('    rate = np.asarray', a)
s = s[:a] + '''    # Correct residual lab shifts in the reference-aligned coupon drift.
    train_design, _ = _design(taus, _inputs(train, x, maps), dt, time)
    train_error = train['strain_curves_obs'] - train['strain_0'][:, None] - train_design @ w
    late = np.median(train_error[:, -6:] / time[-6:], axis=1)
    complete = np.isfinite(train['coupon_features_raw']).all(axis=1)
    train_score, test_score = x @ w[3:], xt @ w[3:]
    offset = np.zeros(len(test['lab_id']))
    for lab in np.unique(train['lab_id'][complete]):
        rows = complete & (train['lab_id'] == lab)
        target = test['lab_id'] == lab
        center = np.median(train_score[rows])
        scale = max(.025, _mad(train_score[rows]))
        score = (train_score[rows] - center) / scale
        y = late[rows]
        intercept, slope = least_squares(
            lambda q: np.r_[q[0] + q[1] * score - y, 2 * q[1]],
            [np.median(y), 0.], loss='soft_l1', f_scale=.012,
        ).x
        offset[target] = intercept + slope * (test_score[target] - center) / scale
''' + s[b:]
p.write_text(s)

import importlib.util, pickle, numpy as np

def load(path):
    spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('candidate', path)
    mod = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
    spec.loader.exec_module(mod)
    return mod.solve_alpha_w01_batch_01

models = [load(p) for p in ('/tmp/alpha_w01_batch_01_offset.py', 'alpha_w01_batch_01_solver.py')]
p = pickle.load(open('public_alpha_w01_batch_01.pkl','rb'))[0]
d, g = p['dataset'], p['gt']; tr, te = d['train'], d['test']; t = d['eval_times']
outs = [f(d) for f in models]
np.testing.assert_array_equal(outs[0]['estimated_taus'], outs[1]['estimated_taus'])
for key, ref in [('predicted_strain','te_clean'),('secant_compliance','te_secant'),('hazard_crossing_times','te_cross')]:
    e = [abs(o[key]-g[ref]) for o in outs]
    worst = [max(a[te['lab_id']==j].mean() for j in range(4)) for a in e]
    pooled = [a.mean() for a in e]
    print(key, 'worst-lab', worst, 'pooled', pooled)
    assert worst[1] < worst[0] and pooled[1] < pooled[0]
lab = tr['lab_id']; folds = lab.copy(); rng = np.random.default_rng(203)
for j in range(4):
    i = rng.permutation(np.flatnonzero(lab == j)); folds[i] = np.arange(len(i))%4
for name, grouping in [('within-lab',folds), ('leave-lab',lab), ('leave-wing',lab//2)]:
    e = np.empty((2, len(lab), len(t)))
    for j in np.unique(grouping):
        keep = grouping != j
        train = {k:v[keep] for k,v in tr.items()}; val = {k:v[~keep] for k,v in tr.items()}
        val['critical_strain'] = val['strain_0'] + .25
        pred = [f({**d, 'train':train, 'test':val})['predicted_strain'] for f in models]
        if name != 'within-lab':
            np.testing.assert_array_equal(*pred)
        e[:,~keep] = abs(np.asarray(pred)-val['strain_curves_obs'])
    metrics = [[max(a[lab==j].mean() for j in range(4)), max(a[lab==j,-1].mean() for j in range(4))] for a in e]
    print(name, 'worst-lab curve and final MAE', metrics)
    if name == 'within-lab':
        assert all(b < a for a,b in zip(*metrics))
